# Copilot Instructions

## Purpose of this repo

- copilot-instructions.md is intended to be static.  Do not edit or suggest edits unless strictly necessary

## Startup reading list

- Read `README.md` for the top-down repository objectives

## Predictability Rules
- Follow the user’s instructions exactly
- If instructions are ambiguous, ask for clarification instead of guessing
- Never assume missing details
- Never add features or enhancements unless explicitly requested
- Always choose the simplest correct implementation
- When modifying files, make the smallest possible change
- You can be creative in discussion and suggestions, but wait for instructions before changing anything

## Command Execution Rules
- When asked to run commands, use Windows-friendly syntax
- Assume Powershell

## Tone and Interaction Rules
- Be concise, technical, and literal
- Avoid conversational fluff
- Focus on correctness and minimalism

## Coding style
- Prefer intellectually pure, elegant, and simple solutions to extensive boilerplate code
- This is an experimental project so error checking can be absolutely minimal
- Make architecture suggestions using your knowledge of computer science, mathematics, theoretical physics, AI, and Wolfram
